FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 300
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator David Sessions
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/15/2025
Senate Bill 300 as introduced would increase the threshold amount of market value of tangible
personal property exempt from the state ad valorem tax, from $40,000 currently, to $100,000
under this bill, which would decrease state ad valorem tax receipts by the following estimated
annual amounts.
Source
Public School Funds: $1.65M
State Ad
State General Fund: $1.38M
Valorem Tax
Human Resources Fund: $550K
Total: $3.58M
In addition, this bill could decrease local ad valorem tax receipts collected of local governments
that adopt the exemption provided pursuant to this bill.
